provenance.what: One synchronous OPD optimizer step with a Qwen3-0.6B policy, a separately allocated Qwen3-1.7B vLLM teacher, exact shared token IDs, and sampled reverse KL.
provenance.produced_by: ci/marin_nightly/run_opd_h100.sh on one Iris H100x4 task
why_these_thresholds: The gate requires teacher-scored tokens and a nonzero teacher advantage over valid training tokens. The driver reports this credit after applying route weights and the teacher coefficient.
A positive raw gradient norm proves the combined objective reached the optimizer. The CPU numerical suite independently proves that changing teacher log-probabilities changes this gradient.
The wall-clock allowance covers cold downloads and vLLM graph capture while remaining a bounded startup and training check.
